title: Emotion-rich ‘Apol of My Ai’ brings kundiman alive for new gen
summary: “Apol of My Ai,” one of seven full-length films competing in the 2026 Puregold CinePanalo Film Festival, is a heartfelt look at first love, family, and growing up.
